ValidationRule.description: CRM-7095: Reinstate CCC Email Bounce Back cases and Bounce Back Automatic Reply
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(OR(RecordType.Name=="CCC Email Bounced Back", RecordType.Name=="System Admin Request"), ISPICKVAL(Origin,"Email"), OR(CONTAINS(LOWER(Subject), "automatic reply"), CONTAINS(LOWER(Subject), "out of office"), CONTAINS(LOWER(Subject), "ooo")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: QCC Case can't be created for Automatic or Out Of Office incoming emails.
